verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents documents configurable retention for conversation transcripts and audio recordings, with a 2-year default that can be changed. That covers the data-retention half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows per-call recording on/off controls or consent and disclosure tooling such as recording announcements or consent capture. Missing for 10: per-call recording toggle, consent/disclosure prompts or capture, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention
